messages:
sam_partnerships: Hey team — Azure sent the final bundle for the offering we promised for the cloud gallery. Need quick signoffs so we can schedule the publish for next Wednesday. Items: logos (SVG + 2 PNG sizes), co-brand lockup, localized one-pager (EN/FR/DE), customer quote + attribution, and legal T&C snippet. Links: https://files.redwood/azure-offering/176543/ (assets.zip)

erica_pm: Thanks — timeline check: can creative + legal finish by EOD tomorrow? PM needs to lock the publish date by Friday.

jordan_creative: Downloaded the pack. Quick notes: partner logo (azure-logo-blue.svg) has extra whitespace on the left; lockup PNGs need 3px padding under the tagline. I can push a patched SVG and two export variants in ~2h. Also adding a small demo screenshot for the one-pager.

maria_legal: Heads-up on the quote — partner provided this line: "Redwood reduced our inference cost by 48%". Need written consent for that exact percentage and the provenance (which benchmark). Also verify that the customer name in the quote has release clearance. I'll ping legal at Azure if needed.

kevin_sales: For the attribution, can we change the customer line to the shorter approved form? Sales prefers: "— Priya N., CTO, CloudWave" instead of full job title + LinkedIn. Less risk.

jordan_creative: Ack. If legal approves the quote text, I can typeset it into the one-pager and export localized PDFs. Localization note: FR text will expand ~18-22% — will need layout tweaks.

michelle_azure: @sam_partnerships confirming Azure is fine with shortened attribution as long as the customer has signed the case release. I'll confirm consent and the benchmarking source tonight.

sam_partnerships: Thanks — action list: 1) jordan to upload patched logo + PNGs (due +2h) 2) erica to confirm publish window 3) maria to request consent + benchmark source 4) kevin to confirm preferred attribution 5) michelle to confirm customer release. Ping me when each is done.

jordan_creative: Uploaded: `azure-logo-blue-patched.svg`, `azure-lockup-240.png`, `azure-lockup-120.png`, `onepager-en-v2.pdf` -> https://files.redwood/azure-offering/176543/updated/ 

maria_legal: I emailed Azure legal with the exact quote and benchmarking ask. If they confirm by EOD we'll be clear. Also flagged GDPR for storing the quoted customer's name in our asset bundle; we should keep the one-pager in the secure marketing folder (restricted access).

erica_pm: Locking publish window to next Wed afternoon (US PST). If legal misses EOD tomorrow, we fallback to publish a teaser (no customer quote) and follow-up case study later.

kevin_sales: If legal needs more time, go teaser route. For the sales enablement deck, I still want a short internal quote placeholder to use in calls — "Customer quote pending release".

michelle_azure: Azure legal confirmed the quote and supplied the benchmark doc (attached). They gave permission for shortened attribution: `— Priya N., CTO, CloudWave`. Copy of consent: https://secure.azure/consents/cloudwave-176543.pdf

sam_partnerships: Perfect. maria, can you confirm storage path and retention period? Also jordan, once you localize FR/DE please drop `onepager-fr-v1.pdf` and `onepager-de-v1.pdf` to the same folder.

maria_legal: Storing assets in `/secure/marketing/partners/azure/176543/` with 2-year retention by default. Access: marketing, sales, partnerships, and legal. If partner requests removal earlier we'll escalate.

jordan_creative: Localized PDFs uploaded: `onepager-fr-v1.pdf`, `onepager-de-v1.pdf`. I adjusted the FR layout and bumped font size for legibility. Links: https://files.redwood/azure-offering/176543/updated/localized/

sam_partnerships: Quick QA checklist before publish: 
- Logos in `/assets/logos/` (SVG, 240px, 120px) :thumbsup:
- Co-brand lockup in PNG and SVG :thumbsup:
- One-pager EN/FR/DE in secure folder :thumbsup:
- Customer quote consent (pdf) :thumbsup:
- Legal retention/storage confirmed :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled window reserved for 2024-11-06 20:00 UTC (pending approvals).

erica_pm: All thumbs up here. I approve publish slot. Sam, you good to hit publish after a final quick pass?

sam_partnerships: Yes — I'll do a final asset pass at 18:00 PST, then kick the publish. Thanks everyone! :tada:
